name: AgentContext
description:
Fivetran's Agent Context MCP provides AI agents the full breadth of business context needed to answer questions and take action, reliably. Built on Fivetran's open context layer, it infers and curates context from every enterprise systems — including data sources, schemas, concepts, knowledge bases, and analytical metadata — and exposes it through the Model Context Protocol.

Agent Context MCP powers natural-language search, data-aware assistants, coding workflows, and custom AI applications. Its standard MCP interface makes it easy to bring rich, trusted, and comprehensive business context into the AI tools teams already use, including Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents, and custom applications.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AgentContext to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AgentContext to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.fivetran.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AgentContext MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AgentContext provides these MCP tools: github_new, gongio, jira, provide_feedback, public_docs, salesforce, slab, and zendesk_new.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AgentContext?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AgentContext in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AgentContext requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AgentContext is developed by Fivetran. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
